analysis.title: Americas Emerging Software: CrowdStrike announces acquisition of Zscaler
key_insights: CrowdStrike announced an all-stock acquisition of Zscaler before the open on 11/23, valuing Zscaler at about $43.9bn. GS estimates this implies 11.2x EV/NTM Sales, about 47x EV/FCF and a 34% premium to ZS close on 11/20.
Close is expected in CrowdStrike's 2HFY28 (ends 1/31/28). Both boards approved unanimously and Zscaler CEO Jay Chaudhry would continue to lead the Zscaler business.

GS says scaled security platforms have mostly used tuck-in deals to outsource R&D. CRWD's comments and PANW's at the CyberArk deal show rising importance of scale and combining network, identity and endpoint telemetry.

CrowdStrike's stated rationale includes entering network security (largest cyber segment, $37bn in 2026E per Gartner), adding Zscaler's Zero Trust SASE, Security for AI and Data Protection to Falcon, and combining datasets to train SafeMind.

CRWD expects cross-sell into 8,000 Zscaler customers that are not yet CrowdStrike customers, with revenue synergies building over 30 months post close to about $1bn annualized run-rate (about 25% of ZS FY27E revenue).
GS views the earnings from CRWD, ZS, PANW and NET as a signal that cyber demand is inflecting, de-risking CY27 outlooks. GS is less concerned than about 2 months ago about an air pocket into 2027.
CRWD 3QF27 net new ARR was $419mn vs Street $347mn (21% above). Revenue was about 4% above, gross margin about 90bps above and EBIT margin about 100bps above, with billings +26%.

CRWD 4Q revenue/ARR guidance is about 1% above Street organically, and FY28 NNARR growth is still expected at least 20% excluding Zscaler. Flex ARR is +100% yoy, Guardian ARR more than doubled qoq to over $100mn, and cloud ARR exceeds $1bn.
ZS 1QF27 net new ARR was $111mn vs Street $96mn (18% above). Revenue beat was only about 1% (smallest in 14 quarters), while NNARR growth ex Red Canary accelerated to 22%.
Zscaler withdrew FY27 guidance and will not host an F1Q earnings call given the deal. GS is Not Rated on both names because it is advising on the transaction.

market_movers.rationale: Announced all-stock acquisition of Zscaler and reported a strong 3Q net new ARR beat. GS is Not Rated due to advisory role.
Being acquired at about $43.9bn, a 34% premium to the 11/20 close. GS is Not Rated due to advisory role.

sector_views.rationale: GS sees demand inflecting and CY27 outlooks de-risked, with urgency from aging infrastructure, agentic attacks and growing agentic traffic.

earnings_insights: CRWD 3QF27 reported net new ARR $419mn vs Street est $347mn, 21% above. Revenue about 4% above Street, EPS 8% and FCF 12% above Street per FactSet.
CRWD 3QF27 reported pro forma EPS $0.34 vs GSe $0.31 and Street $0.31. Net FCF $476mn vs Street est $426mn, total revenue $1,583mn vs Street est $1,528mn.
CRWD no longer reports quarterly DBNRR/GRR but said both accelerated in 3Q. 4Q guidance is about 1% above Street organically, and FY28 NNARR growth of at least 20% excludes Zscaler.
ZS 1QF27 reported net new ARR $111mn vs Street est $96mn. EPS $1.22 vs GSe $1.15 and Street $1.16, revenue $949.3mn vs Street est $937.7mn (+20% yoy).
ZS 1QF27 reported ARR $3,882mn (+21% yoy), FCF $416.5mn vs Street est $408.9mn. FY27 guidance withdrawn and no F1Q call.
GS adjusted CRWD 2027E/2028E/2029E FCF estimates to $1,887/$2,452/$2,975mn and ZS to $917/$1,162/$1,190mn, both forecasts.
risk_factors: Deal must close by CrowdStrike's 2HFY28, with integration of a large network security business and all-stock consideration.
Zscaler's revenue beat was the smallest in 14 quarters.
GS conflict of interest as financial advisor to the transaction.
